parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Code-Checksum
parameters.description: The CRC-64 value of the function code package. This value is used to check data integrity. The value is automatically calculated by a tool.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The time when the function is invoked. The value is in the **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT** format.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Invocation-Type
parameters.description:
The method used to invoke the function. Valid values:

*   **Sync**: synchronous invocation mode
*   **Async**: asynchronous invocation mode

parameters.name: X-Fc-Log-Type
parameters.description:
The method used to return logs. Default value: None. Valid values:

*   **Tail**: returns the last 4 KB of logs that are generated for the current request.
*   **None**: does not return logs for the request.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Trace-Id
parameters.description: The trace ID of the request for Function Compute API.

parameters.name: functionName
parameters.description: The name of function to which the asynchronous task belongs.

parameters.name: invocationId
parameters.description:
The ID of the asynchronous task.

>  If you use an SDK to invoke a function, we recommend that you specify a business-related ID to facilitate subsequent operations. For example, a video processing function can use video file names as invocation IDs. This way, you can easily check whether a video is successfully processed or terminated before it is processed. The ID must start with a letter or an underscore (\_) and can contain letters, digits (0-9), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The ID can be up to 128 characters in length. If you do not specify the ID of an asynchronous invocation, Function Compute automatically generates an ID.

parameters.name: qualifier
parameters.description: The version or alias of the service to which the asynchronous task belongs.

parameters.name: serviceName
parameters.description: The name of service to which the asynchronous tasks belong.
